question: Why did the error rate go up on 03 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: A new deployment of catalog v4.7 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: v4.7 deployment introduced a new version of the RequestHandler that caused NullPointerExceptions.
NullPointerExceptions led to a high error rate in the catalog service.
The error rate increased from 0.45% to 2.49% within 21 minutes of the deployment.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume remained stable before and after the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was due to a sudden change in latency.
ruled_out.reason: The p95 latency remained stable before and after the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is not due to a sudden surge in requests.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is not due to a sudden change in latency.
ruled_out.reason: It rests on a change that is too early, or in a different service/region, to explain a sudden change here.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region us-east rose from 0.45% to 2.49% (+453%), with a change point at 2026-03-03T09:50:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region us-east: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.13).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (727 per 5 min before, 904 per 5 min after, +24%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region us-east stayed about the same (121 ms before, 120 ms after, -1%).
Deployed catalog v4.7 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R013; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
High error rate on catalog in us-east (catalog, us-east; 10 min after the change; record R014; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
Deployed catalog v5.11 to us-east (catalog, us-east; 212 min before the change; record R012; fit: hours before the change, too early to explain a sudden jump)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.7) (catalog, us-east; 21 min after the change; record R015; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
catalog: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v4.7) (catalog, us-east; 26 min after the change; record R016; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the v4.7 deployment to prevent further error rate increase.
Monitor the RequestHandler for potential issues before deploying new versions.
Investigate the root cause of the NullPointerExceptions in RequestHandler.
